article.title: MrShortGame Golf reviews Lucky wedges
article.body:
It's one thing for us to tell you our wedge is good. It's another when somebody who reviews wedges for a living sets ours next to a big-name wedge and lets the camera roll.

That's what MrShortGame Golf did back in 2019, and we're not going to spoil how it ends.

Watch on YouTube · MrShortGame Golf

The first question everybody asks about a gold wedge is whether it's just a gold wedge. Fair question, and it's the one he set out to answer.

The wedge has grown up since

The 60° in that video was where we started. Today's Carver is forged from 1020 carbon steel, so you feel exactly where you caught it, and the face is micro-grooved and sandblasted for spin that shows up even on the ones you don't hit perfectly. It comes in six lofts, from 50° to 60°, and it's still gold, so it still gets asked about.

Carver 02 GoldGold, forged and ready for your own test. $99.
See it

Quick answers

Which Lucky wedge is in the video?

Our original gold 60°, from 2019. Today's version is the Carver 02 Gold.

Can I still buy that wedge?

Its successor is the Carver 02 Gold, which is what we sell today.

Can I try one without the risk?

Yes. Every club comes with sixty days to decide if it's staying in your bag.
